one_liner.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 添加壁纸模糊毛玻璃背景
one_liner.en: Blur the Windows wallpaper behind DSH Desktop

local: Requires the DSH webServer service; README specifies DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 or later.

completeness.reason: Host routes, wallpaper discovery, browser styling, polling, and teardown are implemented.

code.reason: The Host, wallpaper, and browser responsibilities are separated into focused modules with fallback handling.

docs.reason: README explains requirements, installation, behavior, disabling, and limitations.

maintenance.reason: Facts report one commit and no later maintenance history.

tests.reason: Four focused test files cover browser, wallpaper, and Host/client behavior; no CI is reported.

quality.notes: Lite review of entry, bundle, registration, and core behavior; remaining core/build files were not reviewed.
